preconditions.description: The number of vertices n is an integer between 2 and 200,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ai <= n for ai in a)
preconditions.description: Each element ai in the input sequence is an integer between 1 and n inclusive.
The input sequence a has exactly n elements.

postconditions.description: The minimum number of changes required to make the sequence valid is a non-negative integer.

postconditions.expression: is_valid_sequence(valid_sequence) and sum(ai != valid_sequence[i] for i, ai in enumerate(a)) == min_changes
postconditions.description: The output valid_sequence is a valid rooted tree sequence, and the number of changes from the input sequence a to valid_sequence is exactly min_changes.
If min_changes is zero, the input sequence is already valid. Otherwise, there exists at least one valid sequence achievable with exactly min_changes modifications.

invariants.description: A sequence p is valid if and only if it represents a rooted tree with exactly one root (pr = r) and all other vertices have exactly one parent, forming a connected acyclic graph.
A valid sequence exists with at most k changes from the input sequence a if there exists a sequence with exactly k or fewer modifications that satisfies is_valid_sequence.
